$comment: Wall-clock budget in seconds per solver family, published with the benchmark data so a gap figure is never shown without the allowance it was measured under (decisions/benchmarking-design sections 3.2 and 4). 'agreed' records whether the value is fixed by a decision or is still a provisional placeholder: only meta is settled (decision 10, 300s). The rest are working values so the pipeline can be exercised, and tasks/bench-tier-a-campaign is expected to confirm or replace them before results are presented as like-for-like.
